content_blocks.text: As the sun dipped below the horizon, casting a golden glow over the countryside, Eliza found herself alone in the vast library of Elmwood Manor. Rows upon rows of books lined the shelves, each one a potential key to unlocking the secrets of the past. She picked up a leather-bound volume, its pages yellowed with age. As she turned the pages, a faint whisper seemed to echo through the room, making her heart race. The words on the page danced before her eyes, telling stories of love, loss, and betrayal. Each line brought her closer to understanding the true nature of Elmwood’s history.
